title_zh: 中国烹饪协会清理各类称号 “中国烹饪大师”“之乡、之都”等全部作废
title_en: China Cuisine Association Revokes Various Culinary Titles Including 'Chinese Master Chef' and 'Hometown of Food'
summary_zh: 中国烹饪协会近日宣布清理各类烹饪称号，包括“中国烹饪大师”“美食之乡”“美食之都”等，所有相关称号全部作废。
summary_en: The China Cuisine Association recently announced the cleanup of various culinary titles, revoking all such titles as 'Chinese Culinary Master', 'Hometown of Gastronomy', and 'Capital of Gastronomy'.
